DARQ Documentation
==================

DARQ is an automatic quantification pipeline for DaTSCAN images. The project
provides a web-based interface for submitting studies, a FastAPI backend for
job management, and worker processes responsible for executing the DARQ
processing pipeline.

This documentation provides instructions for using and deploying DARQ,
an overview of the system architecture, tutorials, and the Python API
reference.
